title: 冠词与名词的指称
goal: 区分名词的泛指和特指；为名词选择适当的冠词。

points.label: 区分名词的泛指和特指
为名词选择适当的冠词

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 冠词与名词的指称的教学范围、知识点及写作小测规格

body.p: 冠词说明名词指的是不是读者能确定的那一个。单数可数名词前要有冠词或其他限定词。复数名词和不可数名词泛指时，不加冠词。

body.box: A volunteer placed a folder on the desk. The folder contained information about the event.

body.p: a folder 第一次提到一个文件夹，the folder 再次指同一个。information 是不可数名词，不加冠词。情境中只有这一个对象时，第一次提到也用 the。

cards.title: 首次引入与再次提及
rows: 首次引入：一名新人物

An unfamiliar visitor asked about joining the discussion after the morning session had ended.
A volunteer explained the registration procedure to the visitor beside the main entrance.
a volunteer 第一次提到一个人。
首次引入：一个新物品

Several spare containers were available, and none had been selected for the new display.
The assistant chose a container and placed it beside the samples on the table.
a container 指可选容器中的一个。
再次提及：同一物品

A student left a notebook beside the computer used for checking room reservations.
The notebook contained a draft timetable for the student society's activities during the coming term.
the notebook 指前句的同一本。
再次提及：同一人物

A lecturer offered to discuss the proposed project with members of the student research group.
The lecturer suggested a smaller sample that the group could examine within the available time.
the lecturer 指已经引入的同一位。

cards.title: 泛指类别与特指对象
rows: 泛指类别：复数名词

The essay discusses the general value of public spaces rather than any particular park.
Parks provide places where people can spend time outdoors without arranging a formal activity.
Parks 泛指类别，不加 the。
泛指类别：不可数名词

The discussion concerns access to knowledge in general, without selecting one particular document or website.
Information helps people make decisions when it is relevant to the situation they face.
Information 泛指信息，不加 a 或 the。
特指对象：明确限制

The room contains several tables, but only one stands directly beside the main window.
The table beside the window is reserved for visitors who need a brighter working space.
窗边只有这一张桌子，第一次提到也用 the。
特指对象：材料范围

The tutor handed the class a single sheet containing instructions for the afternoon activity.
The information on that sheet explains the sequence of tasks and the materials each group needs.
不可数名词特指时用 the。

cards.title: 冠词与限定词
rows: a / an
用于不特指的单数可数名词。后一个词以元音音素开头时用 an。
The tutor offered an example that showed how a general claim could be supported by evidence.
辅音与元音音素
看读音，不看字母：a university，an hour。
A university student waited for an hour before the office opened for the afternoon session.
the
单数、复数、不可数名词都能用。读者要能从上下文确定指哪个。
The materials listed in the invitation are available from the desk beside the workshop entrance.
零冠词
用于泛指的复数名词和不可数名词。单数可数名词前不能空着。
Students need reliable information when choosing activities that fit their interests and their weekly schedules.
其他限定词
my、this、each 等可以代替冠词，不和 a、the 连用。
This folder contains my notes about the questions raised during the first planning meeting.
a 的类别用法
a 加单数可数名词也可以指一类中的任何一个，不是第一次提到某一个。
A clear heading helps a reader identify the topic before examining the details of a paragraph.

body.box: A student describes a device borrowed for a presentation. Draft: I borrowed projector from the media desk. Projector had a damaged cable. Intended meaning: One previously unidentified projector was borrowed, and the next sentence refers to that same device. The writer is describing this incident rather than projectors as a general class.

body.p: 第一处 projector 是单数可数名词，第一次提到，写 a projector。第二处指同一台，写 The projector。

body.box:
I borrowed a projector from the media desk before the afternoon presentation began.
The projector had a damaged cable, so the assistant provided a suitable replacement.

body.p: 泛指投影仪这一类时，写 Projectors need suitable cables。中文没有冠词，但英语单数可数名词前仍要有冠词或限定词。

items.stem: A writer introduces one previously unidentified workshop among several available options. Which phrase fits?
options: a workshop
the workshop
workshop
an workshop
items.why: 第一次提到一个单数可数名词，用 a。workshop 以辅音音素开头，不用 an。

items.stem: 'A guest entered the hall. The guest carried a small case.' What does the second noun phrase refer to?
options: Any guest who might enter a hall in a similar situation
The same guest introduced in the preceding sentence
All guests who are expected to arrive at the hall
A different guest whose identity has not yet been introduced
items.why: The guest 指前句的 A guest，是同一个人，即第二项。

items.stem: Which phrase fills the blank when referring to instructions in general, not a particular set? '___ should be clear enough for new users.'
options: An instructions
The instructions
Instructions
Those instructions
items.why: 题干说 in general, not a particular set。复数 instructions 泛指时不加冠词，即第三项。

items.stem: Choose 'a', 'an', 'the', or 'zero'. The writer introduces a previously unidentified example: The guide includes ___ example of a completed application.
items.why: 第一次提到一个例子，用不定冠词。example 以元音音素开头，用 an。

groups.text: A student found a blue scarf under a seat in the lecture room. The scarf had no name on it. The student placed it in the only lost-property box at the service desk. A short note explained where it had been found. The account concerns these particular objects, not scarves or boxes in general.

items.stem: Why does 'the only lost-property box' take 'the' even without an earlier mention?
options: The box was already mentioned in the sentence about finding the scarf.
The phrase refers to lost-property boxes in general, not one box.
The short note at the service desk had already named this box.
The words only and at the service desk point to one identifiable box.
items.why: only 和 at the service desk 说明只有这一个箱子，读者能确定指哪个，即第四项。所以第一次提到也用 the。

items.stem: Refer again to the scarf and describe its lack of identification.
items.why: The scarf 指前句的 a blue scarf。The 后面不能再接 a scarf。

items.stem: Choose 'a', 'an', 'the', or 'zero' to refer to the same scarf: The note was placed beside ___ scarf found under the seat.
items.why: 题干说 the same scarf，found under the seat 也限定了对象，用 the。

groups.text: A student helping with a campus trail selects one previously unidentified envelope from several spare envelopes. The student puts a route card inside it and places it at the starting desk. Later, a participant opens that same envelope. This account describes a particular sequence of events, rather than envelopes as a general class.

items.stem: What should 'the envelope' refer to when reporting the participant's action?
options: The same envelope selected and filled by the student
Every spare envelope originally available to the student
Another envelope first introduced by the participant
Envelopes as a whole class of stationery items
items.why: 材料说 opens that same envelope。the envelope 指学生选好并装了卡片的那个，即第一项。

items.stem: Which article fits the first mention: 'The student selected ___ envelope from the spare supplies'?
options: a
an
the
zero
items.why: previously unidentified 说明是第一次提到，用不定冠词。envelope 以元音音素开头，用 an。

items.stem: Refer to the selected envelope when reporting its contents.
items.why: The envelope 指前面那个信封，a card 第一次提到卡片。The 后面不能再接 an envelope。

items.stem: Choose 'a', 'an', 'the', or 'zero' to keep the same reference: Later, the participant opened ___ envelope that the student had prepared.
items.why: that the student had prepared 限定了是哪个信封，用 the。

groups.text: An essay discusses tool sharing in general before describing one campus workshop. It begins with a general claim about tools, without identifying a particular collection. It then describes the workshop's only storage cupboard. The writer contrasts the value of tools as a class with the location of a specific cupboard.

items.stem: Which interpretation correctly contrasts the two noun phrases?
options: Tools refers to one identified set, while the cupboard refers to cupboards in general.
Tools refers to one unidentified item, while the cupboard introduces several storage locations.
Tools refers to a general class, while the cupboard identifies one object in context.
Tools refers to a particular cupboard, while the cupboard describes tools as a class.
items.why: 材料说 tools as a class 和 the workshop's only storage cupboard。前者泛指，后者特指，即第三项。

items.stem: Which version expresses the intended opening generalization?
options: A tools can help students carry out practical tasks during shared workshop activities.
Tool can help students carry out practical tasks during shared workshop activities.
The tools can help students carry out practical tasks during shared workshop activities.
Tools can help students carry out practical tasks during shared workshop activities.
items.why: without identifying a particular collection 说明不特指，排除 the。复数名词泛指时不加冠词，即第四项。

items.stem: Identify the unique cupboard using the definite article.
items.why: 只有这一个存放处，用 the。用 a 就成了几个存放处中的一个。

items.stem: Choose 'a', 'an', 'the', or 'zero'. To refer to tools as a whole class rather than an identified set, the essay uses ___ before plural 'tools'.
items.why: 题干说 a whole class rather than an identified set。复数 tools 泛指时不加冠词。
